LightningComponentBundle.description: Sleek dashboard to visualize execution progress, state history, and manually run durable workflows.

property.name: platformEventWarningPercent
property.label: Platform Event Warning %
property.description: System Doctor shows Warning at this percent of a Platform Event limit. If you leave this blank, System Doctor uses 80.

property.name: platformEventCriticalPercent
property.label: Platform Event Critical %
property.description: System Doctor shows Critical at this percent of a Platform Event limit. The value must be more than the Warning %. If you leave this blank, System Doctor uses 95.
